note: All discovered prepared batches are retained. Preparation is not execution. Snapshot only; no final confirmation or winner claim.

snapshot_semantics.source: file receipts, claims and pinned artifacts; no live ledger read
snapshot_semantics.batch_complete: terminal summary exists; execution_status may be stopped
snapshot_semantics.job_complete: terminal result or dispatch receipt; status retains valid/invalid/error outcome
snapshot_semantics.chronology: prepared file mtime with pinned rebound parent-before-child ordering
snapshot_semantics.current_admission: unique actual lease/dispatch evidence wins over any prepared draft
snapshot_semantics.usage: per-job report; nested campaign values are historical snapshots, not current totals
